No credits in 2nd year for autopay/paperless bill. Includes: All Included TV Pkg, monthly service & equipment fees for one Genie HD DVR, and standard pro installation. termsAndConditions.en: All equipment is leased. Advanced Receiver Service ($15/mo). A monthly fee of $7.00 applies for each receiver and/or Genie Mini/DIRECTV Ready TV on your account. Features Experience breathtaking HD on every connected TV Access to programming based on package selection. Blackout restrictions apply to sports programming. Program must air in HD to record in HD. Enjoy full DVR functionality on every connected TV: Record shows; watch, rewind, fast-forward, and delete record shows; pause and rewind live TV Requires Genie Mini, Wireless Genie Mini, or an RVU-enabled TV/device for each additional room. Additional fees apply. Watch recorded or live TV on up to 4 TVs at once There is a limit of three remote viewing per Genie at a time. Record any 5 shows at the same time, all in HD Access to programming based on package selection. Blackout restrictions apply to sports programming. Program must air in HD to record in HD. Store all your favorite shows with up to 200 hours in HD recording capacity Based on one Genie HD DVR setup (model HR34/44 Advanced Whole-Home DVR only). Actual recording capacity varies based on type of programming being recorded. Program must air in HD to record in HD. Remote viewing requires a model C31 Genie Mini, C41 Wireless Genie Mini, H25 HD Receiver(s) or RVU-enabled TV/device in each additional room, a SWiM network and Advanced Receiver Service ($15/mo.). Visit directv.com/genie for complete details. Enjoy thousands of shows and movies On Demand (the Genie HD DVR must be connected to your home Internet service) Actual number of TV shows and movies will vary. Additional fees required for new titles. Watch live TV on your computer, tablet, or phone Browsing, watching live TV, recording and remote control functionality are available to DIRECTV customers only. DIRECTV customers must have a residential home account registered on directv.com to access application. Genie Recommended on TechRadar's 12 Great Recent Innovations TechRadar is a trademark of Future Publishing Limited and is used with permission. Access to 4K On Demand, plus—for the first time ever—a full-time 4K TV channel. Requires the Genie® HD DVR (HR54), a DIRECTV 4K Ready TV, and SELECT package or higher. Need help getting set up? Call 1-866-257-7817.

description.en: Genie® HD DVR Discount\n

termsAndConditions.en: Does this replace my current package? Yes, this will replace your current package. How much will I be charged? On your next bill, you'll see a credit for the package that you're disconnecting today because you paid in advance. You'll also see a partial charge that covers the new package starting today, and the regular monthly charge that we bill in advance for the following month. How long does activation take? 5 minutes.
